description.default: Start a reviewable benefits-change workflow for a marriage, birth, adoption, relocation, or loss of coverage. Use for prompts such as 'I had a new child and need to update benefits' or 'Start a marriage life event'. Do not use to compare plans without a life event; use CompareBenefitPlans. Pass lifeEvent, effectiveDate, and dependentCount from the prompt, and never submit without user review and confirmation.
